description_sq:

Momentalisht eshte i dhene me qira me nje kontrate afagjate gje qe e bene nje mundesi shume te mire investimi.

Per me teper detaje, me kontaktoni!!
description_en: The environment has a surface of 92.7 m2 with a large and very visible facade on Zogu I Pare Boulevard. The environment is located in one of the main streets of Tirana.
